headers.//: Data for seasons through 2024-25 is finished and can never change, so it is cached hard. Directories are named by a season's start year (2024 = 2024-25), so this matches everything up to and including 2024. Add each season here once it ends — forgetting to only costs a revalidation round trip, which is why the catch-all below is the safe default rather than the other way round.
Everything else under /data — the season index and the season in progress — is rewritten nightly, so it must be revalidated. Unchanged files come back as a 304 rather than a re-download.

rewrites.//: Client-side fallback. Vercel serves any matching file from dist/ first, so every prerendered page still wins; this only catches routes that have no file of their own — a past season's player pages, which render client-side by design. /data and /assets are excluded so a missing data file 404s honestly instead of returning HTML.
